sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上，

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括J.D.·万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 所有人都可以免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: During their historic summit, President Trump, standing next to President Putin, challenged the conclusion of his own government that Russia interfered in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在其历史性峰会期间，特朗普总统站在普京总统身旁，质疑他自己政府关于俄罗斯干预美国

sentences.en: elections.
sentences.zh: 大选的结论。

sentences.en: They think it's Russia, Trump said.
sentences.zh: 他们认为是俄罗斯，特朗普说。

sentences.en: I don't see any reason why it would be.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么理由会是他们。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: Julie Davis, what's the main question?
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯，核心问题是什么？

sentences.en: What's your main question going into this summit on Monday?
sentences.zh: 你对周一这次峰会的核心疑问是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the main question is really, you know, what is Trump going to try to get out of this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，核心问题其实是，你知道，特朗普到底想从中得到什么？

sentences.en: And is he, in this opportunity that he has to sit down with Putin, going to actually bring up some of the
sentences.zh: 而且在这次与普京坐下来谈的机会中，他是否真的会提出

sentences.en: big issues in the relationship, primarily the fact that Russia interfered in the presidential election,
sentences.zh: 两国关系中的重大问题，主要是俄罗斯干预总统大选的事实，

sentences.en: but also Russia's illegal annexation of Crimea, the poisonings of people in Britain that, you know,
sentences.zh: 还有俄罗斯对克里米亚的非法吞并，以及英国发生的那些众所周知的毒杀事件，

sentences.en: Russia has been accused of carrying out.
sentences.zh: 据指控这些都是俄罗斯实施的。

sentences.en: Is the president going to actually press him on these things?
sentences.zh: 总统真的会就这些事情向他施压吗？

sentences.en: Or is it going to be all about, you know, friendliness and reaching out, which is how the president basically seemed to be approaching this in the days leading up to the meeting?
sentences.zh: 还是会完全围绕着友好和接触展开，而这基本上就是总统在会晤前的几天里所表现出的态度？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And all this is coming just three days after these latest indictments from the special
sentences.zh: 而这一切发生的时间，距离特别检察官

sentences.en: counsel Robert Mueller's investigation, indictments of Russian government officials, which left it
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·穆勒调查发布最新起诉书仅仅过去三天，这些针对俄罗斯政府官员的起诉书，

sentences.en: essentially undeniable that Russia meddled in the 2016 election and that it was orchestrated by Putin and his government.
sentences.zh: 使得俄罗斯干预2016年大选且由普京及其政府策划这一事实变得基本上不容否认。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this was always going to be a topic of conversation at this meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这本来就是这次会晤中必然会谈论的话题。

sentences.en: He said that he was going to ask him about it even before we knew that these indictments were going to happen.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我们知道这些起诉书会出台之前，他就说过会向他询问此事。

sentences.en: But certainly once they came down on Friday, it completely sort of changed the cast of the summit.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，一旦它们在周五公布，就彻底改变了这次峰会的基调。

sentences.en: And was this going to change the president's tack on this, his approach to Putin on the issue?
sentences.zh: 这会改变总统对此事的方针、他对普京在此问题上的态度吗？

sentences.en: Or was he going to do what he's done in the past was essentially to ask the question?
sentences.zh: 还是他会重蹈覆辙，基本上就是问个问题，

sentences.en: But when Putin has denied it, you know, he's basically moved on from it.
sentences.zh: 但当普京否认时，你知道，他就基本上把这页翻过去了。

sentences.en: And the fact that the indictments came down on Friday made let's just move on just really impossible.
sentences.zh: 而起诉书在周五出台这一事实，使得“我们翻篇吧”变得实在不可能。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what happens as this day begins in Helsinki that gives us some idea of what the answer will be this time?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这天在赫尔辛基开始时，发生了什么能让我们对这次的答案略知一二呢？

sentences.en: So for his part, the president started the day with a series of fiery tweets.
sentences.zh: 就他而言，总统以一系列激烈的推文开始了新的一天。

sentences.en: President Trump, as he is wont to do, starts tweeting, quote, our relationship with Russia has never been worse, thanks to many years of U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统照例开始发推文，大意是，由于美国多年的

sentences.en: foolishness and stupidity, and now the rigged witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 愚蠢和无知，以及现在这场被操纵的政治迫害，我们与俄罗斯的关系从未如此糟糕。

sentences.en: Which, of course, is his way of referring to the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 这当然是他指代穆勒调查的方式。

sentences.en: So right off the bat, he's essentially parroting or projecting the Putin narrative, the Russian narrative, which is that
sentences.zh: 所以一上来，他基本上就在重复或迎合普京的叙事、俄罗斯的叙事，即

sentences.en: it's the United States that is responsible for the difficulties in the relationship.
sentences.zh: 是美国应当为两国关系中的困难负责。

sentences.en: It's the
sentences.zh: 是

sentences.en: United States that's been at fault.
sentences.zh: 美国一直存在过错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That we haven't pursued a better and warmer relationship with Russia, and it's time to change that.
sentences.zh: 认为我们没有寻求与俄罗斯建立更好、更温暖的关系，现在是时候改变了。

sentences.en: And so that was the going in posture.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是当时的初始姿态。

sentences.en: And very quickly, within an hour, I think, the Russian foreign ministry retweeted the president of the United States and said, we agree.
sentences.zh: 而且很快，我想在一个小时内，俄罗斯外交部就转发了美国总统的推文并表示，我们同意。

sentences.en: We agree with the president of the United States' sentiment that the problem here, even though we have meddled in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们同意美国总统的看法，即这里的问题在于美国，尽管我们干预了美国

sentences.en: election, the problem here is the United States.
sentences.zh: 大选，但这里的问题是美国。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that tweet and the Russian agreement with it, that now kind of feels like a harbinger for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 那条推文以及俄罗斯对此的认同，现在听起来就像是接下来一整天的预兆。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And good morning to you.
sentences.zh: 祝你早安。

sentences.en: A bit of drama this morning as this summit is already an hour behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨有点小插曲，因为这次峰会已经比预定时间晚了一个小时。

sentences.en: So, for a while, after President Trump has tweeted and he's met with the Finnish president, he's waiting for Putin to arrive.
sentences.zh: 因此，在特朗普总统发了推文并会见芬兰总统之后，他有一段时间一直在等待普京到达。

sentences.en: He was scheduled to arrive just about an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 他原本计划在大约一个小时前到达。

sentences.en: But as President Putin likes to do, he likes to keep other world leaders waiting.
sentences.zh: 但正如普京总统喜欢做的那样，他喜欢让其他世界领导人等待。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin likes to arrive late to meetings like this.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京喜欢迟到参加这样的会议。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Kind of a power play.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种权力的施展。

sentences.en: The president of the United States is now walking in to meet with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 美国总统现在正走进去会见弗拉基米尔·普京。

sentences.en: Thank you, everybody.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And there you see that handshake and warm words between President Trump and President Putin.
sentences.zh: 在那里你可以看到特朗普总统和普京总统握手并互致亲切问候。

sentences.en: Then, you know, the reporters filed out and it was time for them to meet alone with just their translators.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，记者们退场了，接下来是他们单独会面，只有各自的译员在场。

sentences.en: And that's just what they did.
sentences.zh: 他们也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: President Trump is now meeting behind closed doors with Russian President Vladimir Putin at Finland's presidential palace.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统目前正与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在芬兰总统府闭门会谈。

sentences.en: And then they were supposed to spend 90 minutes together.
sentences.zh: 按计划他们本应在一起度过90分钟。

sentences.en: Instead, they spent more than two hours together, just the two of them and their interpreters with no advisers present.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们在一起待了两个多小时，只有他们两个人以及各自的口译员，没有顾问在场。

sentences.en: Now, President Trump, who brags about his ability to make a deal, is sitting down with one of the most experienced players on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 现在，这位常常吹嘘自己交易能力的特朗普总统，正与世界舞台上经验最丰富的玩家坐在一起。

sentences.en: Which was a prospect that had really alarmed a lot of people going in.
sentences.zh: 这一前景在会前确实让许多人感到恐慌。

sentences.en: During Putin's time in power, he's met with every U.S.
sentences.zh: 在普京执政期间，他会见了自比尔·克林顿以来的历任美国

sentences.en: president since Bill Clinton.
sentences.zh: 总统。

sentences.en: Because it's kind of a big deal when the presidents of the United States and Russia talk together.
sentences.zh: 因为当美国总统和俄罗斯总统进行会谈时，这绝对是一件大事。

sentences.en: And for there to be no historical record at all of that is pretty extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 而对此竟然完全没有留下历史记录，这就相当非同寻常了。

sentences.en: So the two presidents, we expect to come out any moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们预计两位总统随时都会出来。

sentences.en: We're watching that door.
sentences.zh: 我们正盯着那扇门。

sentences.en: So it was a longish wait.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场稍显漫长的等待。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of anticipation because nobody really knew what we were going to hear.
sentences.zh: 大家充满期待，因为没有人真正知道我们会听到什么。

sentences.en: Were they going to come out with some big announcement?
sentences.zh: 他们会带着什么重磅声明出来吗？

sentences.en: Were they going to make nice?
sentences.zh: 他们会表现友好吗？

sentences.en: Were they going to be very testy with each other?
sentences.zh: 他们会互相针锋相对吗？

sentences.en: We want to have some sense of what happened.
sentences.zh: 我们想要对发生的事情有个大致了解。

sentences.en: As we noted, there was no agenda.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所指出的，这次会晤没有议程。

sentences.en: It was just kind of a black box.
sentences.zh: 它就像是一个黑箱。

sentences.en: So that's where we were when the two presidents walked in.
sentences.zh: 这就是两位总统走进来时的背景。

sentences.en: So the two of them come out of the suicide door and they take their place at their lecterns.
sentences.zh: 于是两人从侧门走出，在各自的讲台前站定。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: President Putin spoke firSt.
sentences.zh: 普京总统首先发言。

sentences.en: Distinguished Mr. President, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 尊敬的总统先生，女士们先生们。

sentences.en: He essentially started out by saying, you know, listen, we've had this tension and there's no reason for it.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是以这样的话开头的：听着，我们之间一直存在这种紧张关系，但这毫无必要。

sentences.en: The Cold War is a thing of paSt.
sentences.zh: 冷战已成为过去式。

sentences.en: The situation in the world changed dramatically.
sentences.zh: 世界局势发生了剧烈变化。

sentences.en: You know, he really, I think, was trying to strike the tone of, you know, we're world leaders and we should be on an equal plane.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为他确实试图营造这样一种基调：我们是世界领导人，我们应该处于平等地位。

sentences.en: Today's negotiations reflected our joint wish, our joint wish with President Trump to redress this negative situation in the bilateral relationship.
sentences.zh: 今天的谈判反映了我们的共同愿望，即我们与特朗普总统共同的愿望，即纠正双边关系中的这种消极局面。

sentences.en: And of course, this is part of Putin's objective here is to be seen as not a pariah, not as someone who invades countries and murders people,
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是普京此行的目的之一，即不被视为一个被孤立者，不被视为一个侵略国家和谋杀他人的人，

sentences.en: but as someone who's a big player on the world stage and worthy of a summit with the American president.
sentences.zh: 而是被视为世界舞台上的重量级玩家，配得上与美国总统举行峰会。

sentences.en: Once again, President Trump mentioned the issue of the so-called interference of Russia within the American elections.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统再次提到了所谓俄罗斯干预美国大选的问题。

sentences.en: He did mention what he called the so-called interference of Russia.
sentences.zh: 他确实提到了他所谓的俄罗斯所谓干预。

sentences.en: The Russian state has never interfered and is not going to interfere into internal American affairs, including election process.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯国家从未干预也绝不打算干预美国内部事务，包括选举进程。

sentences.en: And he kind of ended it on a positive note.
sentences.zh: 他最后以积极的基调作结。

sentences.en: He said, In general, we are glad with the outcome of our first full-scale meeting.
sentences.zh: 他说，总的来说，我们对首次全面会晤的成果感到满意。

sentences.en: We had a good conversation with President Trump, and I hope that we start to understand each other better.
sentences.zh: 我们与特朗普总统进行了良好的对话，我希望我们能开始更好地理解彼此。

sentences.en: And I'm grateful to Donald for it.
sentences.zh: 为此我感谢唐纳德。

sentences.en: And it was pretty clear he was happy with the way things went, but he wasn't, you know, gloating.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他对事情的进展感到高兴，但他并没有，你知道，沾沾自喜。

sentences.en: He was just being very matter of fact and laying out what he thought that they had both gotten out of the talk.
sentences.zh: 他只是非常客观地陈述了他认为双方从这次会谈中各自得到了什么。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And then.
sentences.zh: 然后。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I have just concluded a meeting with President Putin on a wide range of critical issues for both of our countries.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚结束了与普京总统就两国一系列至关重要的问题进行的会晤。

sentences.en: We had direct, open, deeply productive dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了直接、公开、极具建设性的对话。

sentences.en: Went very well.
sentences.zh: 进展非常顺利。

sentences.en: It was Trump's turn.
sentences.zh: 轮到特朗普了。

sentences.en: A productive dialogue is not only good for the United States and good for Russia, but it is good for the world.
sentences.zh: 富有成效的对话不仅对美国有利，对俄罗斯有利，对世界也有利。

sentences.en: And he kind of portrayed it as a political risk for him.
sentences.zh: 他把这描绘成他自己承担的一个政治风险。

sentences.en: I would rather take a political risk in pursuit of peace than to risk peace in pursuit of politics.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿为了追求和平而承担政治风险，也不愿为了追求政治而拿和平去冒险。

sentences.en: As president, I will always put what is best for America and what is best for the American people.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，我永远把对美国最有利、对美国人民最有利的事放在首位。

sentences.en: That, you know, he was willing to take this big risk because, you know, there's a historic opportunity here to, like, repair the relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你知道，他愿意冒这个大险，因为，你知道，这里存在一个历史性的机遇，比如修复与俄罗斯的关系。

sentences.en: And he made this comment.
sentences.zh: 他发表了这样的评论。

sentences.en: But our relationship has never been worse than it is now.
sentences.zh: 但我们的关系从未像现在这样糟糕。

sentences.en: However, that changed as of about four hours ago.
sentences.zh: 然而，在大约四个小时前，情况改变了。

sentences.en: I really believe that.
sentences.zh: 我真的坚信这一点。

sentences.en: Meaning like he, Donald Trump, by having this meeting had essentially just kind of changed the relationship and that this was the dawn of something much better.
sentences.zh: 意思是说他，唐纳德·特朗普，通过这次会晤实质性地改变了两国关系，而这正是一个好得多的新时代的曙光。

sentences.en: During today's meeting, I addressed directly with President Putin the issue of Russian interference in our elections.
sentences.zh: 在今天的会晤中，我直接向普京总统提出了俄罗斯干预我们大选的问题。

sentences.en: And during his opening statement, the president said that he had addressed directly with Putin the issue of Russian interference in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在开场白中，总统表示他已经直接向普京提出了俄罗斯干预美国

sentences.en: election.
sentences.zh: 大选的问题。

sentences.en: And he said.
sentences.zh: 并且他说。

sentences.en: I felt this was a message best delivered in person.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个最好当面传达的信息。

sentences.en: Our ears all kind of perked up and we thought, oh, maybe this is it.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都竖起了耳朵，心想，哦，也许就是这样。

sentences.en: He's condemning this.
sentences.zh: 他在谴责这种行为。

sentences.en: Spent a great deal of time talking about it.
sentences.zh: 花了大量时间讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: And President Putin may very well want to address it.
sentences.zh: 普京总统很可能也想讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: And very strongly, because he feels very strongly about it and he has an interesting idea.
sentences.zh: 而且态度非常坚决，因为他对此感触很深，并且他有一个有趣的观点。

sentences.en: And then that was it.
sentences.zh: 然后就结束了。

sentences.en: This is the moment that you've been waiting for and in a sense all of us have been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们一直在等待的时刻，从某种意义上说也是我们所有人一直在等待的时刻。

sentences.en: Not just since these indictments on Friday, but maybe even since the meddling occurred, that standing together in front of the public,
sentences.zh: 不仅从周五的这些起诉书算起，甚至可能从干预事件发生之日起，我们就期待着他能公开站在一起，

sentences.en: the president would speak candidly and confrontationally about this interference, this historic interference in our election.
sentences.zh: 坦率而对立地谈论这场干预，这场对我们选举的历史性干预。

sentences.en: And he does that instead.
sentences.zh: 而他却反其道而行之。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was striking because the way he phrased it, that it was a message best delivered in person.
sentences.zh: 是的，这太令人震惊了，因为他的措辞听起来这是一个最好当面传达的信息。

sentences.en: You could imagine him going on to say, you know, and the message is, you've attacked our democracy.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象他接着会说，你知道，信息就是，你们攻击了我们的民主。

sentences.en: You better not do it again.
sentences.zh: 你们最好别再这么做了。

sentences.en: Here's the price you're going to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 这就是你要为此付出的代价。

sentences.en: But there was none of that.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有那些事。

sentences.en: And, you know, here he is on the stage with Putin standing right next to him.
sentences.zh: 你看，他站在普京就站在他身旁的舞台上。

sentences.en: And whether or not he had brought it up privately, this would have been the moment on the world stage to say to people, I'm taking this guy to task.
sentences.zh: 无论他私下里有没有提过，这本来都是在世界舞台上向大家表明“我要找这小子算账”的时刻。

sentences.en: I am holding him to account.
sentences.zh: 我要追究他的责任。

sentences.en: And he just was not going to go there.
sentences.zh: 但他就是不肯顺着这个方向说。

sentences.en: This was a very constructive day.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常富有建设性的一天。

sentences.en: This was a very constructive few hours that we spent together.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在一起度过的非常有建设性的几个小时。

sentences.en: It's in the interest of both of our countries to continue our conversation.
sentences.zh: 继续我们的对话符合我们两个国家的利益。

sentences.en: And we have agreed to do so.
sentences.zh: 我们已经同意这样做。

sentences.en: I'm sure we'll be meeting again in the future, often.
sentences.zh: 我确信我们以后还会经常见面。

sentences.en: And hopefully we will solve every one of the problems that we discussed today.
sentences.zh: 希望我们能解决今天讨论的每一个问题。

sentences.en: So, again, President Putin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 所以，再次感谢普京总统，非常感谢。

sentences.en: So then, you know, they finished their statements and it was time to take questions from the press.
sentences.zh: 接着，你看，他们发表完声明，就到了接受记者提问的时候了。

sentences.en: Mr. President, you tweeted this morning that it's U.S.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，你今天早上发推文说，是美国

sentences.en: foolishness, stupidity, and the Mueller probe that is responsible for the decline in U.S.
sentences.zh: 的愚蠢、无知以及“通俄门”调查，才导致了美俄

sentences.en: relations with Russia.
sentences.zh: 关系的恶化。

sentences.en: President Trump is asked by Jeff Mason, the reporter for Reuters.
sentences.zh: 路透社记者杰夫·梅森向特朗普总统提问。

sentences.en: Do you hold Russia at all accountable for anything in particular?
sentences.zh: 你认为俄罗斯对任何具体事情负有责任吗？

sentences.en: And if so, what would you consider them that they are responsible for?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，你认为他们应该承担什么责任？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我这么认为。

sentences.en: I hold both countries responsible.
sentences.zh: 我认为两个国家都有责任。

sentences.en: And the president essentially says no.
sentences.zh: 而总统基本上回答说没有。

sentences.en: I think that the United States has been foolish.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国一直很愚蠢。

sentences.en: I think we've all been foolish.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所有人都很愚蠢。

sentences.en: We should have had this dialogue a long time ago, a long time, frankly, before I got to office.
sentences.zh: 我们早就该进行这种对话了，坦白说，早在我就任之前很久就该有了。

sentences.en: And I think we're all to blame.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们都有责任。

sentences.en: He doesn't take the opportunity again to take Putin to task for anything.
sentences.zh: 他再次错失了就任何事情质问普京的机会。

sentences.en: I think that the probe is a disaster for our country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这项调查对我们国家是一场灾难。

sentences.en: Then he kind of pivots from the general to the specific and starts talking about the Mueller probe.
sentences.zh: 随后他从宏观转向微观，开始谈论起“通俄门”调查。

sentences.en: I think it's kept us apart.
sentences.zh: 我认为它让我们疏远了。

sentences.en: It's kept us separated.
sentences.zh: 它让我们分开了。

sentences.en: There was no collusion at all.
sentences.zh: 根本没有勾结。

sentences.en: Everybody knows it.
sentences.zh: 人人都知道这一点。

sentences.en: People are being brought out to the fore.
sentences.zh: 人们被推到了聚光灯下。

sentences.en: So far that I know, virtually none of it related to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，几乎没有一件事与竞选有关。

sentences.en: And they're going to have to try really hard to find somebody that did relate to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 他们得费老鼻子劲去寻找某个与竞选有关的人。

sentences.en: That was a clean campaign.
sentences.zh: 那是一场干净的竞选。

sentences.en: I beat Hillary Clinton easily.
sentences.zh: 我轻而易举地击败了希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: And frankly, we beat her.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我们击败了她。

sentences.en: And I'm not even saying from the standpoint we won that race.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不是从我们赢得那场比赛的角度来说的。

sentences.en: And it's a shame that there can even be a little bit of a cloud over it.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这上面竟然还能有一点阴云。

sentences.en: People know that.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道这一点。

sentences.en: People understand it.
sentences.zh: 人们都明白这一点。

sentences.en: But the main thing, and we discussed this also, is zero collusion.
sentences.zh: 但最主要的事情，我们对此也进行了讨论，那就是零勾结。

sentences.en: And it has had a negative impact upon the relationship of the two largest nuclear powers in the world.
sentences.zh: 这对手中拥有世界上百分之九十核力量的两个超级大国之间的关系产生了负面影响。

sentences.en: We have 90 percent of nuclear power between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 我们两国的核力量占了百分之九十。

sentences.en: It's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: It's ridiculous what's going on with the probe.
sentences.zh: 这场调查简直荒谬透顶。

sentences.en: You know, that was a pretty striking moment where, you know, he's for weeks and months, his advisors have been saying, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是一个相当引人注目的时刻，几个星期、几个月来，他的顾问们一直都在说，

sentences.en: we are holding Russia accountable for its malign activities.
sentences.zh: 我们要让俄罗斯为其恶意活动承担责任。

sentences.en: And here's a direct question about do you hold Russia accountable for anything?
sentences.zh: 而这里有一个直接的问题：你是否让俄罗斯承担任何责任？

sentences.en: And the president doesn't mention anything.
sentences.zh: 但总统却什么都没提。

sentences.en: And he's instead blaming the Mueller probe.
sentences.zh: 相反，他在指责“通俄门”调查。

sentences.en: For President Putin, if I could follow up as well.
sentences.zh: 普京总统，如果我也能追问一个问题的话。

sentences.en: And then Putin is asked by the same reporter, the American reporter from Reuters.
sentences.zh: 接着，同一位记者、路透社的美国记者向普京提出了问题。

sentences.en: Why should Americans and why should President Trump believe your statement that Russia did not intervene in the 2016 election, given the evidence that U.S.
sentences.zh: 鉴于美国情报机构提供的证据，为什么美国人和特朗普总统应该相信你关于俄罗斯没有干预2016年大选的说法？

sentences.en: intelligence agencies have provided?
sentences.zh: 情报机构提供的证据？

sentences.en: And will you consider extraditing the 12 Russian officials that were indicted last week by a U.S.
sentences.zh: 你是否会考虑引渡上周被美国大陪审团起诉的12名俄罗斯官员？

sentences.en: grand jury?
sentences.zh: 大陪审团起诉的12名俄罗斯官员？

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to let the president answer the second part of that question.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这个问题的前半部分我让总统来回答。

sentences.en: And Trump jumps in before Putin has a chance.
sentences.zh: 还没等普京有机会开口，特朗普就抢先插话了。

sentences.en: But, as you know, the whole concept of that came up perhaps a little bit before, but it came out as a reason why the Democrats lost an election, which, frankly,
sentences.zh: 但如你所知，整个概念可能稍微早一点出现，但它被提出来，是因为民主党人输掉了大选——坦白说，

sentences.en: they should have been able to win because the Electoral College is much more advantageous for Democrats, as you know, than it is to Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他们本来应该能赢的，因为如你所知，选举人团制度对民主党人比对共和党人更有利。

sentences.en: We won the Electoral College by a lot, 306 to 223, I believe, and that was a well-fought, that was a well-fought battle.
sentences.zh: 我们在选举人团中以极大优势获胜，我记得是306票对223票，这是一场艰苦卓绝的战斗。

sentences.en: We did a great job.
sentences.zh: 我们干得太棒了。

sentences.en: And essentially, it's very clear that he thinks this question about 12 Russian officers who are, again, accused of attacking the American electoral system,
sentences.zh: 基本上，很明显他认为关于这12名被指控攻击美国选举系统的俄罗斯官员的问题，

sentences.en: that the whole issue is meant to undercut him.
sentences.zh: 整个事件的目的都是为了拆他的台。

sentences.en: He is completely focused on the fact that these people were not affiliated with his campaign and has nothing to do with him.
sentences.zh: 他完全专注于这些人与他的竞选无关、与他毫无关系这一点上。

sentences.en: Just to say it one time again, and I say it all the time, there was no collusion.
sentences.zh: 再强调一次，我一直都在说，根本没有勾结。

sentences.en: I didn't know the president.
sentences.zh: 我不认识那位总统。

sentences.en: There was nobody to collude with.
sentences.zh: 根本没有人可以去勾结。

sentences.en: So he views it through the prism of his own campaign and his election, not the Democratic system and the electoral process that was undermined.
sentences.zh: 所以他是通过自己的竞选和大选的有色眼镜来看待这件事的，而不是从被破坏的民主制度和选举程序来看。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We ran a brilliant campaign, and that's why I'm president.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一场精彩绝伦的竞选，这就是为什么我是总统。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So then, you know, it's Putin's turn to answer, and at this point, he basically doesn't have to say anything anymore.
sentences.zh: 接着，你看，轮到普京回答了，这时候他基本上什么都不用再说了。

sentences.en: Trump has already made his case.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经把他的观点都表达清楚了。

sentences.en: As to who is to be believed and who is not to be believed, you can trust no one if you take this.
sentences.zh: 至于该相信谁、不该相信谁，如果按这种逻辑，你谁也不能信。

sentences.en: Where did you get this idea that President Trump trusts me or I trust him?
sentences.zh: 你从哪儿得出这种想法，觉得特朗普总统信任我或者我信任他？

sentences.en: He defends the interests of the United States of America, and I do defend the interests of the Russian Federation.
sentences.zh: 他捍卫美利坚合众国的利益，而我捍卫俄罗斯联邦的利益。

sentences.en: And he essentially says, you know, there's no proof.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，你看，没有任何证据。

sentences.en: We should be guided by facts.
sentences.zh: 我们应该以事实为准绳。

sentences.en: Could you name a single fact that would definitively prove the collusion?
sentences.zh: 你能说出一个能确凿证明勾结的事实吗？

sentences.en: This is utter nonsense.
sentences.zh: 这简直是无稽之谈。

sentences.en: Just like the president recently mentioned.
sentences.zh: 就像总统刚才提到的那样。

sentences.en: Like, just listen to your own president.
sentences.zh: 比如，听听你们自己的总统怎么说。

sentences.en: He just denied that we did this.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚否认了我们做过这种事。

sentences.en: So, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的。

sentences.en: Don't take my word for it.
sentences.zh: 别听我怎么说。

sentences.en: Yeah, take your own president's word for it.
sentences.zh: 去听听你们自己的总统怎么说。

sentences.en: That was really striking, because, you know, a lot of these encounters are about message and what's said in public and what is seen in public.
sentences.zh: 那真是太引人注目了，因为，你知道的，其中许多会面都关乎信息传递、公众场合的言论以及公众眼中的形象。

sentences.en: And the spectacle of the two of them up there,
sentences.zh: 他们两个站在那里，

sentences.en: both defending Russia and essentially rolling their eyes and calling ridiculous the basis of a federal investigation that's been legitimized by the entire intelligence community of the United States was something.
sentences.zh: 一边为俄罗斯辩护，一边翻着白眼，把整个美国情报界合法化的联邦调查局调查的基础斥为荒谬，这真是活久见。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The final question from the United States.
sentences.zh: 来自美国的最后一个问题。

sentences.en: We'll go to Jonathan Lemire from the AP.
sentences.zh: 我们将提问美联社的乔纳森·莱米尔。

sentences.en: The second American question, the final American question, was from the Associated Press Reporter.
sentences.zh: 第二个美国问题、最后一个美国问题来自美联社记者。

sentences.en: And he basically just put it to President Trump very directly.
sentences.zh: 他基本上非常直接地向特朗普总统提出了这个问题。

sentences.en: Who do you believe?
sentences.zh: 你相信谁？

sentences.en: Just now, President Putin denied having anything to do with the election interference in 2016.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，普京总统否认与2016年选举干预有任何关系。

sentences.en: Every U.S.
sentences.zh: 每一个美国

sentences.en: intelligence agency has concluded that Russia did.
sentences.zh: 情报机构都断定俄罗斯参与了。

sentences.en: What, who, my first question for you, sir, is who do you believe?
sentences.zh: 我的第一个问题是，先生，你相信谁？

sentences.en: My second question is, would you now, with the whole world watching, tell President Putin, would you denounce what happened in 2016 and would you warn him to never do it again?
sentences.zh: 我的第二个问题是，现在全世界都在看着，你愿不愿意告诉普京总统，你是否谴责2016年发生的事情，并警告他永远不要再这样做？

sentences.en: This is kind of the final chance for Trump to say something judgmental at all about the Russian interference in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是特朗普在幕后主使面前，对美军选举干预发表任何带有评判性言论的最后机会。

sentences.en: election in front of the man who directed it.
sentences.zh: 美军选举干预发表任何带有评判性言论的最后机会。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So let me just say that we have two thoughts.
sentences.zh: 那么让我来说说，我们有两种想法。

sentences.en: You have groups that are wondering why the FBI never took the server.
sentences.zh: 有些群体在纳闷，为什么联邦调查局从未拿走服务器。

sentences.en: And he sort of pivots to this idea of where are Hillary Clinton's emails?
sentences.zh: 他又顺势扯到了希拉里·克林顿的电子邮件在哪里这个问题上。

sentences.en: What happened to the servers of the Pakistani gentleman that worked on the DNC?
sentences.zh: 在民主党全国委员会工作的巴基斯坦先生的服务器怎么了？

sentences.en: Where are those servers?
sentences.zh: 那些服务器在哪里？

sentences.en: They're missing.
sentences.zh: 它们不见了。

sentences.en: Where are they?
sentences.zh: 它们在哪？

sentences.en: What happened to Hillary Clinton's emails?
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿的邮件怎么了？

sentences.en: 33,000 emails.
sentences.zh: 三万三千封邮件。

sentences.en: Gone.
sentences.zh: 没了。

sentences.en: Just gone.
sentences.zh: 就这样没了。

sentences.en: I think in Russia they wouldn't be gone so easily.
sentences.zh: 我想在俄罗斯，它们可没那么容易消失。

sentences.en: And why didn't the FBI gain access to the servers at the DNC that were hacked into?
sentences.zh: 为什么联邦调查局没有获取遭到黑客攻击的民主党全国委员会服务器的权限？

sentences.en: Why was the FBI told to leave the office of the Democratic National Committee?
sentences.zh: 为什么联邦调查局被告知离开民主党全国委员会的办公室？

sentences.en: I've been wondering that.
sentences.zh: 我一直在纳闷这件事。

sentences.en: I've been asking that for months and months and I've been tweeting it out and calling it out on social media.
sentences.zh: 我几个月来一直在问这个问题，一直在发推特并在社交媒体上大声疾呼。

sentences.en: Where is the server?
sentences.zh: 服务器在哪里？

sentences.en: And he essentially says, I don't know which to believe.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，我不知道该相信哪一个。

sentences.en: And he kind of indicates that he leans toward Putin.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上暗示自己倾向于普京。

sentences.en: I have President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我有普京总统。

sentences.en: He just said it's not Russia.
sentences.zh: 他刚说过不是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: I will say this.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是。

sentences.en: I don't see any reason why it would be.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么理由会是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But I really do want to see the server.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想看到那个服务器。

sentences.en: But I have confidence in both parties.
sentences.zh: 但我对双方都有信心。

sentences.en: And he said, I have confidence in both parties.
sentences.zh: 他说，我对双方都有信心。

sentences.en: Both parties.
sentences.zh: 双方。

sentences.en: Both Vladimir Putin and his intelligence officials.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京和他的情报官员。

sentences.en: So I have great confidence in my intelligence people.
sentences.zh: 所以我对我的情报人员充满信心。

sentences.en: But I will tell you that President Putin was extremely strong and powerful in his denial today.
sentences.zh: 但我得告诉你，普京总统今天的否认态度极其坚决、极其有力。

sentences.en: I mean, it's essentially as if he's making excuses for Putin, who's sitting there smirking and looks like feeling very good about himself.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这基本上就像是在为普京开脱，而普京坐在那里假笑，看起来自我感觉非常良好。

sentences.en: Julie, what is the reaction in the room at this moment?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，此刻房间里的反应是怎样的？

sentences.en: I mean, what is it like to be in that room as the President of the United States rejects his own country's version of events in favor of Russia's?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当美国总统拒绝自己国家的事件版本、转而支持俄罗斯的版本时，身处那个房间里是什么感觉？

sentences.en: This country that we are accusing of having done this.
sentences.zh: 我们正在指责这个国家干了这事。

sentences.en: I think that it took everyone's breath away.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让所有人都倒吸了一口凉气。

sentences.en: I mean, some of these things are things that we have heard the President say snippets of before.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中有些事情我们以前听过总统说过片段。

sentences.en: But it's a very different thing for him to be on foreign soil with the President of Russia and undercutting his whole administration and his whole government.
sentences.zh: 但他在异国他乡与俄罗斯总统在一起，并拆自己整个政府和行政当局的台，这是完全不同的另一回事。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, there was a lot of looking around at each other, like, is this really happening?
sentences.zh: 所以我想，你知道的，大家都在面面相觑，心想：这真的在发生吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And what does this actually mean?
sentences.zh: 这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: And at a certain point, after that last question was asked and he did not take the side of the United States, it was almost like the oxygen had been sucked out of the room.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，在问出最后一个问题之后，他没有站在美国这一边，房间里的氧气仿佛瞬间被抽干了。

sentences.en: It was just very hushed.
sentences.zh: 当时的气氛非常安静。

sentences.en: Julie, the whole time I'm watching this, honestly, I'm just wondering why?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，我一直在看这个，老实说，我只是在想，为什么？

sentences.en: Like, genuinely, why would the President do this?
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的，总统为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: What is to be gained for him and for the United States in seeming to side with Russia over his own country and his own government at such a sensitive moment when Russia's role in attacking our free elections is becoming more and more undeniable?
sentences.zh: 在这样一个敏感的时刻，当俄罗斯攻击我们自由选举的作用越来越不可否认时，他这样做对他自己、对美国有什么好处，让他看起来竟然站在俄罗斯一边，而不是他自己的国家和政府？

sentences.en: Who gains from that?
sentences.zh: 谁从中获益？

sentences.en: I think it's really hard to say.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很难说。

sentences.en: I don't believe that this was a well-thought-out, well-planned-out reaction that he had to these questions.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是他对这些问题做出的经过深思熟虑、精心策划的反应。

sentences.en: What we saw was the President being defensive about something that he considers to be an affront to his legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，总统在为他认为是对其合法性的冒犯进行辩解。

sentences.en: And he could not see past that.
sentences.zh: 他无法看透这一点。

sentences.en: And it was not, I don't think, to him at that moment about national security or the standing of the United States in the world.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他在那一刻考虑的是国家安全或美国在世界上的地位。

sentences.en: It was about him and feeling like he was being undermined and undercut and that he could never be as powerful as he wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 他考虑的是自己，觉得自己受到了破坏和削弱，觉得他永远无法拥有自己想要的权力。

sentences.en: He could never have this kind of relationship that he wants to have with Russia as long as this was hanging over him.
sentences.zh: 只要这事一直压在他心头，他就永远无法与俄罗斯建立他想要的那种关系。

sentences.en: And I think that he feels on some level that any acknowledgement of what has happened, that it somehow means that he's not a legitimate president.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他在某种程度上觉得，任何对所发生事情的承认，某种程度上都意味着他不是一个合法的总统。

sentences.en: And so he's not willing to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以他不愿这么做。

sentences.en: Do you think that many of us are sort of misunderstanding this moment?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们中的许多人是不是有点误解了这个时刻？

sentences.en: Because I think most of us saw these 12 indictments coming three days before this summit as basically requiring Trump to finally condemn Russia's meddling in the election.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得我们大多数人在这次峰会前三天看到这12起起诉书时，基本上都认为这要求特朗普最终谴责俄罗斯对选举的干预。

sentences.en: But it's what's actually happening that the timing of these indictments is causing Trump to be more inclined to defend Putin and less willing to criticize him because of the questions that it raises about his election in 2016 and about his legitimacy.
sentences.zh: 但实际情况是，这些起诉书的时机导致特朗普更倾向于为普京辩护，而更不愿意批评普京，因为这引发了关于他2016年选举及其合法性的问题。

sentences.en: I think that's possible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是有可能的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that part of the message from the indictments on Friday, part of the expectation was almost, well,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为周五起诉书传达的信息的一部分，部分期望几乎是，嗯，

sentences.en: this gives the president a much stronger hand going into these meetings to basically, you know, throw the document down in front of Putin and say, look, we know this happened.
sentences.zh: 这让总统在进入这些会议时拥有更有利的筹码，基本上，你知道，把文件往普京面前一摔，说，看，我们知道这发生了。

sentences.en: What are we going to do about it?
sentences.zh: 我们打算怎么处理？

sentences.en: And that it would in some way ease the conversation for him to say, we're holding you accountable.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上会简化他的对话，让他可以说，我们在追究你的责任。

sentences.en: This is what we've got.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们掌握的情况。

sentences.en: How are we going to make sure this doesn't happen again?
sentences.zh: 我们要如何确保这种事不再发生？

sentences.en: But I think instead, as you say,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得相反，正如你所说，

sentences.en: it almost feels to him like the vice is getting tighter and the narrative that he doesn't like that Russia helped him to win the election is gaining ground because these indictments are so clear and detailed about how it happened.
sentences.zh: 这让他觉得紧箍咒越来越紧，他不喜欢的“俄罗斯帮助他赢得选举”这种说法正在占据上风，因为这些起诉书非常清晰、详细地说明了它是如何发生的。

sentences.en: And instead of kind of strengthening his hand, which it would have done for any other American president in this position, I think he felt that it undercut him even further.
sentences.zh: 非但没有增强他的筹码——这对处于这个位置的任何其他美国总统来说都是如此——反而让他觉得自己受到了进一步的削弱。

sentences.en: And so he's even less willing to acknowledge that there's anything to hold Russia accountable for a question for president for president for president Putin.
sentences.zh: 因此，他更加不愿意承认有什么理由要追究俄罗斯总统普京的责任。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: So how does this summit finally end, Julie?
sentences.zh: 那么这次峰会最终是如何结束的，朱莉？

sentences.en: Well, so President Putin has asked.
sentences.zh: 好的，普京总统被问到了。

sentences.en: Do you does the Russian government have any compromising material on President Trump or his family?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府是否有关于特朗普总统或其家人的任何妥协材料？

sentences.en: And he kind of pauses while the translation goes through and laughs and kind of roll his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他在翻译进行的同时停顿了一下，笑了笑，还翻了个白眼。

sentences.en: And he said, yeah, I've heard those rumors.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，我听过这些传言。

sentences.en: Well, distinguished colleague, let me tell you this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，尊贵的同事，我这么跟你说吧。

sentences.en: When President Trump visited Moscow back then, I didn't even know that he was in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统当年访问莫斯科时，我甚至不知道他在莫斯科。

sentences.en: It's nothing.
sentences.zh: 这根本不算什么。

sentences.en: Well, it's difficult to imagine another nonsense of a bigger scale than this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，很难想象还有比这更大规模的无稽之谈了。

sentences.en: Well, please just disregard these issues and don't think about this anymore again.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请不要管这些问题，再也不要想这个了。

sentences.en: So at that point, Trump jumps back in.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，特朗普又插话了。

sentences.en: And the last thing he says is, if Putin had anything on me, it would have been out long ago.
sentences.zh: 他说的最后一句话是，如果普京真有什么关于我的把柄，早就被曝光了。

sentences.en: And if anybody watched Peter Strzok testify over the last couple of days and I was in Brussels watching it, it was a disgrace to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 如果任何人过去几天看了皮特·斯特佐克的作证——我在布鲁塞尔观看了——那是FBI的耻辱。

sentences.en: It was a disgrace to our country.
sentences.zh: 这是我们国家的耻辱。

sentences.en: And you would say that was a total witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 你会说那是一场彻底的政治迫害。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And then he turned on his heel and he walked out.
sentences.zh: 然后他转身走了出去。

sentences.en: So President Trump's final words on this historic day at the end of this summit is that the Mueller investigation,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这次峰会结束这个历史性的一天里，特朗普总统的最后一番话是，穆勒调查——

sentences.en: which just indicted 12 of Putin's officials for hacking the United States election, was a total witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 该调查刚刚起诉了普京的12名官员，指控他们黑客攻击美国选举——是一场彻底的政治迫害。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Julie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报App已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间去探索付费墙背后《时报》订户每天都能看到的内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》App并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: As we mentioned, there is considerable consternation on Capitol Hill about the president's comments today.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所提到的，国会山对总统今天的言论感到相当震惊。

sentences.en: Many lawmakers from both parties were stunned and even angered by what they heard at the Helsinki summit, with some suggesting President Trump was outfoxed.
sentences.zh: 两党的许多议员对他们在赫尔辛基峰会上听到的话感到震惊甚至愤怒，一些人暗示特朗普总统被耍了。

sentences.en: In the hours after the summit on Monday, both Democratic and Republican lawmakers expressed shock over Trump's remarks.
sentences.zh: 在周一峰会结束后的几个小时里，民主党和共和党议员都对特朗普的言论表示震惊。

sentences.en: We do now have a statement just in from Senator John McCain.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到了参议员约翰·麦凯恩的一份声明。

sentences.en: I want to read it to you in its entirety because it is a powerful statement.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家完整地宣读它，因为它是一份很有力量的声明。

sentences.en: Senator McCain says,
sentences.zh: 麦凯恩参议员说，

sentences.en: Senator McCain went on to say,
sentences.zh: 麦凯恩参议员接着说，

sentences.en: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer demanded congressional hearings about the summit, imploring his Republican colleagues to join him.
sentences.zh: 参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默要求就此次峰会举行国会听证会，并恳求他的共和党同僚加入他的行列。

sentences.en: For the president of the United States to side with President Putin against American law enforcement, American defense officials, American intelligence agencies, is thoughtless,
sentences.zh: 美国总统竟然站在普京总统一边，反对美国的执法人员、美国的国防官员、美国的情报机构，这是轻率的、

sentences.en: it's dangerous, it's weak.
sentences.zh: 这是危险的，这是软弱的。

sentences.en: The president is putting himself over our country.
sentences.zh: 总统把自己的利益置于我们国家之上。

sentences.en: But Republican leaders refrained from criticizing the president directly.
sentences.zh: 但共和党领导人没有直接批评总统。

sentences.en: Instead, they said they trusted the U.S.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们表示，比起普京，他们更信任美国

sentences.en: government over Putin.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell told reporters that,
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔告诉记者，

sentences.en: And in its latest prosecution against a Russian national, the FBI has charged a 29-year-old woman with carrying out a secret Russian effort to influence American politics,
sentences.zh: 在其对一名俄罗斯国民的最新起诉中，联邦调查局指控一名29岁女子执行一项秘密的俄罗斯行动，以影响美国政治，

sentences.en: including two attempts to broker a meeting between President Trump and President Putin during the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 包括在2016年竞选期间两次试图促成特朗普总统与普京总统的会面。

sentences.en: The FBI alleges that, at the behest of a senior Russian official, the woman, Maria Butina, made connections through groups like the National Rifle Association
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局称，这名女子玛丽亚·布蒂娜在一名俄罗斯高级官员的授意下，通过全国步枪协会等组织建立联系，

sentences.en: to try to steer the Republican Party toward more pro-Russian policies.
sentences.zh: 试图引导共和党采取更多亲俄政策。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要全黑才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡觉会失去知觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
